question: Can part of a senior executive's bonus be held back and paid later depending on risk?
reference: Yes. A portion of variable pay, as decided by the Board, may be deferred over the time horizon of the risks; deferral can cover cash and non-cash components, and the Board decides the deferral period.

question: Can part of a senior executive's bonus be held back and paid later depending on risk?
reference: Yes. A portion of variable pay, as decided by the Board, may be deferred over the time horizon of the risks; deferral can cover cash and non-cash components, and the Board decides the deferral period.
answer: Yes, according to para 35(3) of the Governance Directions, a certain portion of the variable pay awarded after performance assessment may be deferred by the Board of an NBFC to a time horizon of the risks, and this deferral arrangement can apply to both cash and non-cash components [1][2]. Additionally, under para 37, deferred compensation to senior management may be subject to malus and / or clawback arrangements in the event of subdued or negative financial performance or employee misconduct [3]. These provisions apply to NBFCs in the Middle Layer (NBFCs-ML) and Upper Layer (NBFCs-UL) [1]. The statutory auditor must certify compliance with this requirement every quarter [1].
